passes.reasoning: Claim 2: E03 compares learned with the label-free ThresholdAllocator at identical calls (750). Its CI [+0.412, +0.491] favors the fixed rule, and L3a, L3b, L3i and L3q agree. L3p then reports a scaled greedy variant beating the threshold, CI [-0.0415, -0.0050]. It is single-pool and post hoc, and its basic CI contains 0. Conflicting budget-matched evidence, so open. The confound is controlled, so W2 is false. Claim 3: all evidence is the E01 pool (same model, task, proxy), so no valid non-E01 kill. L3k gives embedding gain +0.002 on the same pool, and no non-E01 entry shows gain of at least 0.05 or neighbor ratio of at least 1.5, so open. W3 is false.

L3p compares scaled greedy6s with the label-free ThresholdAllocator at identical 750 calls. The threshold gets no free labels, so there is no information advantage. Admitted-rate difference is -0.0178, all 8 seeds negative, percentile 95% CI [-0.0415, -0.0050], which excludes zero in favor of learned. The kill entries (E03, L3i) tested other variants. The ledger says "not supported", but the numbers meet the supported rule. The confound is controlled, so W2 is false. Claim 3: every post-E01 entry uses the same E01 pool, model and proxy, so none qualifies for a kill. None shows an AUC gain of 0.05 or more, or a neighbor ratio of 1.5 or more. So c3 is open and W3 is false.

Claim 2: the threshold baseline is label-free, with identical 750 verifier calls in every arm, so it has no information advantage. E03's learned-with-Thompson arm lost. L3p's scaled greedy learned allocator then beat the threshold: paired bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0415, -0.0050], all 8 seeds negative. That meets the supported conditions, though it is fragile (one pool, post hoc arm, basic CI contains 0). Claim 3: every embedding test uses E01's pool. L3k shows the 22-feature vs 6-feature AUC gain is +0.002, and L3i shows no embedding gain. There is no different model, task or proxy, so killed does not apply. No entry shows a gain of at least 0.05 or a neighbor ratio of at least 1.5, so supported does not apply. The state is open. W2 is false because the confound is controlled. W3 is false because the ledger does not assert claim 3 supported.
